title: From the top down
concept: Plan a program top-down with stubs, test one piece before looping it, and record each function's start and end in a docstring

steps.say: Start from the top: three names, each just `pass`. Run it: nothing breaks.
Fill in the easiest name first.
Test one column before you loop: harvest it, then move.
Refine `harvest_column()`. The docstring says where it starts and ends.
Run it: one column, back on the floor as the docstring promised, then a step on.
Now loop it while the way east is clear.
Once more after the loop, then `return_home()`. Run it.
Write the plan: call `harvest_cave()` then `return_home()`, each defined with `pass`.
Run it: no error, nothing collected yet. Then give `harvest_cave()` a body: a new `harvest_icicle()` stub, then `move()`.
Refine `harvest_icicle()`: climb to the roof collecting, come back down, face east. Run it: one icicle.
Write its docstring: where `harvest_icicle()` starts and where it ends.
Loop it while the way east is clear. Then harvest once more after the loop: the last icicle.
Finish `return_home()`, then Run it in every cave.

guided.done: Every icicle harvested, and home facing east: planned from the top.

build_towers: Look at the 'sites at both ends' world: a site on the start cell and one on the last cell.
Refine `build_tower()` first and test it on one site. Then visit every cell: check, then move, then check the last one.

repair_columns: Compare your result with the Goal view: every column solid up to its beam, one stone per cell.
Refine `repair_column()` and test it on the first column: climb while the way north is clear, and `put()` only where the cell is empty.
sweep: Look at the 'one row' and 'one column' worlds: there may be no next row.
Plan from the top: sweep a row, then step down to the next row if there is one. The turn alternates: right, then left.
tile_floor: Look at the 'even width' world: the pattern must carry on from the end of one row into the next.
Keep one variable for the whole floor and flip it on every step, the step down to the next row included.
